# Foto Laminate Precision

> Delhi-based manufacturer of photo lamination machines and photo-finishing equipment. Factory-direct pricing, pan-India delivery, 25+ years of industry experience, 5,000+ machines sold.

Foto Laminate Precision (M/S Mela Ram & Sons) designs and manufactures cold and hot lamination machines, UV coating machines, photo album making machines, and finishing equipment for photo studios, printing shops, retail businesses, government offices, educational institutions, and ID card manufacturers across India. Every machine is built in-house at the company's Delhi facility using CNC precision engineering and is backed by nationwide installation, spare parts, and after-sales support. The company holds an ISO-aligned quality process, IndiaMART Trust Seal verification, PAMA membership, and 25+ industry awards from events such as SIGN INDIA, MEDIA EXPO, and PHOTOFAIR.
